Optimal.Notes: 40 Hz refresh with a 40 fps cap gives perfectly smooth, tear-free gameplay; FSR upscaling from 1024x640 keeps the GPU load manageable while medium textures preserve ship and water detail. This is the sweet spot for a slow-paced naval MMO on the Deck.

profiles.Summary: World of Warships runs on Steam Deck via Proton at a playable level, though the online-only MMO nature means a stable internet connection is essential and some launcher/login quirks may occur. The game's PC minimum requirements are modest (GT 640 class), putting the Deck's RDNA 2 GPU well above minimum, so reasonable frame rates are achievable at medium settings.
profiles.BasisNote: No specific Steam Deck player reports were available; profiles are estimated from the PC minimum/recommended requirements (the Deck's GPU comfortably exceeds minimum specs), the ProtonDB gold/trending-platinum tier, and known Wargaming launcher behaviour on Linux. On first launch, verify the game starts correctly via GE-Proton, check frame rates in a busy battle, and adjust shadow and effects quality first if performance dips.

MaxBattery.Notes: Render at 960x600 and upscale with FSR to stretch battery life; the naval gameplay is not fast-paced enough for low frame rates to feel punishing. GE-Proton is recommended by the community for Wargaming titles to help with launcher compatibility.

KnownIssues: The Wargaming Game Center launcher may interfere with startup — running the game directly via Steam with the correct launch options may be required.
Online-only gameplay means any network interruption ends the session; Wi-Fi reliability on the Deck is critical.
Some ProtonDB reporters note login or account authentication issues that may require extra steps on first launch.
Controller/gamepad support is limited; a keyboard and mouse or touchscreen controls may be needed for menus and gameplay.

MaxPerformance.Notes: At full 1280x800 and high settings the Deck can approach 60 fps in open water but may dip to 45 fps during heavy combat with many ships and effects on screen. Drop shadow quality to Low or reduce render distance if frame rate becomes unstable in port or large fleet battles.

Optimal.Notes: A locked 40 fps at 40 Hz gives a noticeably smooth feel on the OLED panel with good visual quality; FSR upscaling from 1024x640 keeps GPU load comfortable. This is the recommended everyday profile for most players.

profiles.Summary: World of Warships runs at gold/platinum tier on the Steam Deck via Proton, making it broadly playable with some Wargaming launcher quirks to work through on first launch. The Steam Deck's RDNA 2 GPU comfortably exceeds the minimum PC requirements, and the slow-paced naval combat makes 30-40 fps very comfortable for the genre.
profiles.BasisNote: No specific Steam Deck player reports were available; profiles are estimated from PC minimum/recommended requirements compared to Deck hardware. On first run, check frame rate during a full fleet battle (the most GPU-intensive scenario) and drop to Optimal or Max Battery if performance dips below your target.

MaxBattery.Notes: Rendering at 960x600 with FSR upscaling and a hard 6 W TDP cap squeezes maximum session length from the 50 Wh battery. Naval battles are slow-paced enough that 30 fps feels perfectly smooth for this genre.

KnownIssues: The Wargaming Game Center launcher may require manual steps to complete installation before the game itself launches under Proton.
GE-Proton is frequently recommended over default Proton to avoid launch failures related to Wargaming's background services.
No official controller support — input relies on the Steam Deck's touchpads and gyro configured as mouse, which requires setup in Steam Input.
Online-only requirement means the game is unplayable without a stable network connection regardless of local settings.

MaxPerformance.Notes: Full native 1280x800 at high settings is achievable given the Deck's GPU exceeds minimum requirements comfortably, but expect frame rate to dip toward 45-50 fps during large fleet engagements with heavy particle effects. Battery life will be short at full TDP.
